books.name: Leviticus
books.long: LEVITICUS Godthu ḻakarama yukurra rom, nhaltjan ŋuli yolŋu walala marrtji galkithirri nhanukala

books.name: Numbers
books.long: NUMBERS Ḻakarama yukurra Godku yolŋu'‐yulŋunha ŋunha ŋanhdharkŋura

books.name: Deuteronomy
books.long: DEUTERONOMY Guyaŋinyamirriyama yukurra ḻakarama Godku rom nhanukalayŋumirriwu yolŋu'‐yulŋuwu

books.name: Judges
books.long: JUDGES Ḻakarama yukurra ŋurru'‐ŋurruŋunha yolŋu'‐yulŋunha Godkuŋu nherraṉarawuynha walŋakunharawu nhanukalayŋuwu yolŋu'‐yulŋuwu

books.name: 1 Samuel
books.long: 1 SAMUEL Ḻakarama yukurra dhäwu Djamiyulwalaŋuwuy ga Djolwalaŋuwuy

books.name: 1 Kings
books.long: 1 KINGS Ḻakarama yukurra Ŋurru'‐ŋurruŋunha Djudawuynha ga Yitjuralpuynha

books.name: 2 Kings
books.long: 2 KINGS Ḻakarama yukurra wiripu‐guḻku'nha Ŋurru'‐ŋurruŋunha Djudawuynha ga Yitjuralpuynha

books.name: Ezra
books.long: EZRA Ḻakarama yukurra dhäwu Yitjurawalaŋuwuy, ŋunhi ŋayi yukurrana gäŋala roŋiyinmaraŋala Godku yolŋu'‐yulŋunha Djurutjalamlili

books.name: Nehemiah
books.long: NEHEMIAH Ḻakarama yukurra dhäwu' Niyamayawalaŋuwuy, ŋunhi ŋayi dhuḻ'yurruna biyapul ḻoḻu Djurutjalambuy

books.name: Isaiah
books.long: ISAIAH Yitjayayunydja yukurra ḻakarama yalalaŋumirriwuna, ŋunhi yurru yolŋu walala nhina yukurra mäwaya'na yanana, rom‐dhunupana wal'ŋu

books.name: Jeremiah
books.long: JEREMIAH Djiramayawuŋu dhäruk raypirri'yunarawuy, ŋurikiy ŋunhi mari yurru buna, liŋgu walalaŋgalaŋuwuy yätjpuy

books.name: Ezekiel
books.long: EZEKIEL Djekilwuŋu dhäruk raypirri'yunarawuy, ŋurikiy ŋunhi Godthu yurru dhä‐ḏir'yun dhuwurr‐yätjmirrinhanydja, ga rom‐dhunupamirrinydja yurru nhina walŋamirrina

books.name: Daniel
books.long: DANIEL Ḻakarama yukurra Dänyulnha, ŋunhi ŋayi ŋuli yukurranha yuwalkkunha märr‐nherraṉminya Godkala

books.name: Hosea
books.long: HOSEA Yutjiyawuŋu dhäruk, ḻakarama yukurra nhäyinyara Godku märr‐ŋamathinyarawuy

books.name: Joel
books.long: JOEL Djawulwuŋu dhäruk, ŋunhi ŋayi wäthurruna yukurrana ḻakaraŋala ŋapa‐nherraṉarawuna romgu yätjkunydja

books.name: Amos
books.long: AMOS Waymutjkuŋu dhäruk raypirri'yunarawuy, ŋurikiy ŋunhi Godthu boŋguŋu dhä‐ḏir'yurruna ŋunhinhanydja walalanha ŋunhi walala ŋuli muŋdhun yukurra ŋurruwuyknha

books.name: Obadiah
books.long: OBADIAH Wupatayawuŋu dhäruk raypirri'yunarawuy, ŋurikiy ŋunhi Godthu boŋguŋu dhä‐ḏir'yurruna ŋunhinhanydja walalanha ŋunhi walala ŋuli ŋayaŋu‐yätjkunha nhanŋuway yolŋu'‐yulŋunha

books.name: Jonah
books.long: JONAH Ḻakarama yukurra Djawunanha, ŋunhi ŋayi yukurrana marŋgithina Godku, ŋunhi ŋayinydja mel‐wuyunamirrina God

books.name: Micah
books.long: MICAH Maykawalanydja dhärukthu yukurra ḻakarama ŋunhi boŋguŋu wäŋa dhuwala buku‐ḻiw'maraŋunydja ŋorri mäwaya'ŋurana

books.name: Habakkuk
books.long: HABAKKUK Wapakak yukurra ḻakaranhamirri ŋanyapinyay ŋayi, ŋunhi ŋayi ŋuli yukurra märr‐nherraṉmirri Godkala marimirriyu wäŋayu

books.name: Zechariah
books.long: ZECHARIAH Djakarrayayunydja yukurra ḻakarama ŋunhina walu, ŋunhi ŋayi boŋguŋu Godthu liliyi roŋinyamaraŋu nhanŋuwaynydja miṯtjinha

books.name: Malachi
books.long: MALACHI Malakayyunydja yukurra ḻakarama Godnha, ŋunhi ŋayi ŋuli yukurra goŋmirriyama yolŋunha, ŋunhi walala ŋuli ŋayaŋu‐dhapinya wekanhamirri

books.name: Acts
books.long: DHIYAŊU DJORRA'YU ḺAKARAMA YUKURRA NHALTJANARA MARRTJINYARA GODKUŊU DJÄMAWUY

books.name: 1 Dhatjalunikapuyŋuwu
books.long: DHATJALUNIKAPUYŊUWU NAMBA 1 DHÄRUK DHATJALUNIKALILI DHÄRUK DJUY'YUNARA BOLWUŊU

books.name: DJOTKUŊU DHÄRUK
books.long: DJOTKUŊU DHÄRUK DJUY'YUNARA DJOTKUŊU DHÄRUK DJUY'YUNARA

books.name: GODKUŊU WARRAŊULKUNHARANA
books.long: DHIYAŊUNYDJA DJORRA'YU ḺAKARAMA YUKURRA GODKUŊU WARRAŊ ULKUNHARANA MALŊ'MARANHARA DJONGALANYDJA MEL-YURTHINYARAYU
